title: Cognitive Mapping of Learning by Thinking Mechanisms in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit capabilities that resemble human Learning by Thinking (LbT), the acquisition of new insight through internal processes such as explanation and reasoning, without new external input. A systematic account of the cognitive mechanisms behind these capabilities, and of their limits, remains underdeveloped. This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four mechanisms (Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization) onto computational processes in LLMs. Drawing on representative methods, including chain-of-thought prompting, self-consistency, self-reflection, Tree-of-Thoughts search, Self-Instruct, and self-taught reasoning, the analysis argues that selected methods can functionally approximate aspects of these mechanisms and can improve performance on some tasks without additional labeled examples, although this does not always

translated_title: 大语言模型中“思考式学习”机制的认知映射
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益展现出类似人类“思考式学习”的能力，即通过解释、推理等内部过程获取新的洞见，而无需新的外部输入。然而，对这些能力背后的认知机制及其局限性的系统性阐述仍不完善。本文提出了一个认知式思考式学习框架，将四种机制（反思性推理、合成记忆形成、内部模拟与概念自组织）映射到大语言模型的计算过程上。通过分析链式思维提示、自洽性、自我反思、思维树搜索、Self-Instruct 以及自授推理等代表性方法，分析认为所选取的方法可以在功能上近似这些机制的某些方面，并能在无需额外标注样本的情况下提升某些任务的性能，尽管这并不总是……
tldr: 本文提出认知式思考式学习框架，将反思性推理、合成记忆形成、内部模拟和概念自组织四种认知机制映射到大语言模型的计算过程，并论证思维链、自我反思等代表性方法可在功能上近似这些机制，从而无需额外标注数据即可提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Cognitive LbT Framework that maps four cognitive mechanisms—Reflective Reasoning, Synthetic Memory Formation, Internal Simulation, and Conceptual Self-Organization—onto computational processes in LLMs, arguing that representative methods like chain-of-thought prompting and self-reflection can functionally approximate these mechanisms and improve task performance without additional labeled examples.
